annotations.title: Create a store product in RevenueCat

description: Creates a product the store already has in the app's RevenueCat project, under the same identifier so purchases unlock what they should, and optionally adds it to an entitlement and to a package of the current offering. values: platform (ios or android), storeId (the store's product ID; a Google Play subscription is "product:basePlan"), kind (subscription, consumable, non_consumable), displayName, entitlementId and packageId (from ploa_revenuecat_product_options). Always waits for a person's approval when an agent asks.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

name: ploa_revenuecat_create_product
title: Create a store product in RevenueCat
